name: BOE Varitronix Limited
summary: BOE Varitronix Limited, an investment holding company, designs, manufactures, and sells liquid crystal display and related products in the People's Republic of China, Europe, the United States, Korea, Japan, and internationally. It primarily provides thin film transistor (TFT) products, touch panel display modules, and automotive system products. The company also offers display products for use in automotive digital instrument cluster displays, center information displays, head-up displays, rear view and side view e-mirror displays, and highly-integrated digital cockpit displays, as well as mobile phones, tablets, notebooks, monitors, televisions, and automotive displays; and products for us…
